intro: A CTC path contains timing repetitions and blank symbols. The order of collapsing repeats and removing blanks determines the decoded sequence.
task: Merge consecutive identical path IDs, then remove blank IDs, returning the remaining token IDs.
requirements: path is an integer vector with IDs 0..1000000; blank_id is an integer in that range. Return a one-dimensional integer NumPy array, which may be empty.
Repeats separated by a blank must survive as separate output tokens. Only directly adjacent identical path entries merge.

Use finite real numeric values of magnitude at most 1e6, excluding boolean inputs. Each array axis has 1..64 entries and at most 65536 elements total unless a stricter bound is stated. Return NumPy arrays for array outputs, preserve caller inputs, and raise ValueError for invalid inputs.

hints.title: Follow the data
hints.body: Remember the previous raw path symbol, including blanks.

hints.title: Check the boundary
hints.body: Removing blanks first would incorrectly merge tokens that were separated by a blank.

explanation: CTC separates alignment length from output-token length. Several framewise alignments can therefore decode into the same shorter sequence.

A blank carries alignment information even though it disappears from the final text. In particular, it permits two consecutive copies of the same output label to be represented without collapsing into one.
